About Bollam Rishithej

Indian deep-tech founder and operator. Managing Director of ML Dynamic Solutions, and a director and co-founder across ventures in agentic AI security, computer vision, electrochemical sensing, healthcare revenue intelligence, capital management and industrial operations.

Bollam Rishithej is a high-conviction technology entrepreneur, executive operator, and principal investor. Holding a Master of Science in Advanced Mechanical Engineering with Management from the University of Leicester (United Kingdom), he combines European institutional rigor with the high-velocity execution of India's startup ecosystem.

His operational model executes a disciplined dual-engine doctrine: on one axis, building and scaling frontier software and deep-tech enterprises (electrochemical sensing, autonomous cybersecurity agents, computer vision, and algorithmic healthcare finance); on the other, compounding cash flows through established ground-truth heavy trading and industrial assets.

Recognized under the Government of India's DPIIT framework across multiple portfolio entities, his enduring vision is to cement India as the primary engine for global deep-tech breakthroughs—incubating sovereign intellectual property built from India to dominate global markets.
